citation: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, Enforcement and Compliance History Online (ECHO), SDWA data download, accessed September 29, 2026.
note: This value is the share of people on community water systems. Their system had at least one health-based Safe Drinking Water Act violation in 2023–2025. One large system can decide a county's value. One violation of any length counts. Private wells are not covered. Interpretations here are not EPA's.

datasets.title: Drinking water health-based violations
datasets.unit: percent of people on community water systems
datasets.method: Population served by active community water systems with a health-based violation overlapping 2023–2025, divided by population served by all active community water systems listing the county, times 100
datasets.note: This value is the share of people on community water systems in the county. Their system had a health-based violation in 2023–2025. A violation can be a contaminant level, a treatment technique or a disinfectant limit. County details show the number of people and the number of systems.
